question: Should these Matrix, Mattermost, Signal, Slack, and shared delivery-contract changes land as one protocol-hardening batch after the identified recorder fix and proof work?
rationale: The patch changes several independent public protocols and shared delivery infrastructure, so maintainers must confirm that the combined contract choices match intended provider behavior.

options.title: Validate and land together
options.body: Fix existing recorder permissions, resolve conflicts, remove the changelog edit, and provide exact-head protocol evidence for every affected provider.

options.title: Split by provider
options.body: Separate shared infrastructure and each provider into narrower PRs so native behavior and compatibility can be reviewed independently.

options.title: Pause the batch
options.body: Keep the draft open until authoritative protocol references and compatible-client evidence are available.

recommendation.title: Validate and land together
recommendation.body: Fix existing recorder permissions, resolve conflicts, remove the changelog edit, and provide exact-head protocol evidence for every affected provider.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent channel-driver and Crabline recorder work makes RomneyDa the strongest available routing candidate for this cross-provider delivery review.
